args.purpose: Classify the remaining visible condition of this changed S7 dealership preview from a host vision transcript. Do not infer hidden defects or original-game fidelity.
args.context: The user authorized bounded fin-only geometry cleanup. The host visually inspected both fresh images; Jev receives text only. Native body transforms and other106 output preservation are checked separately.

classes.description: The transcript establishes a remaining visible detached, misplaced or badly clipping assembly requiring another transform or placement fix. Retained native cavity/endpoints by themselves do not establish this.

Visible body and parts sit together, the authorized fin cleanup improves the broad intrusion, and remaining native cavity/endpoints or contact/fidelity limitations are explicitly retained without an established new placement defect.
The supplied transcript lacks enough coherent placement evidence to distinguish a remaining assembly defect from retained native geometry or appearance; further direct inspection is required.

items.text: vp_sln_s7_06 dealership, final e80a6f8bed28be7bd5d665dd84f342c07d3f74ee1bded1699c13de3c38e9eb85 GLB: Both fresh rear-quarter and rotated side/front views show the main body, doors, mirrors, wheels, rear lights and wing seated together. The side intake dividers remain present. Relative to the inspected prior views, the broad fin faces extending across the rocker boundary are reduced, leaving thin divider ends. Dark and gray surfaces remain inside the skirt cavity, including the upper rear intake background; these retained native main-skirt surfaces are not evidence of a newly detached door. This is a deliberately modified derived preview with bounded fin thinning. Small blade-to-shell contacts remain; these two views do not prove zero intersections, hidden-face contact clearance, or original-game shader fidelity.
